exercises.title: Log Many
instructions: Use Log Many to log all three: Log Many    ${user}    ${status}    ${count}

exercises.title: Test Failure Analysis
exercises.description: Intentionally fail a test to see error messages.
instructions: Use Should Be Equal with custom message
Should Be Equal    ${actual}    ${expected}    msg=Values do not match: expected ${expected} but got ${actual}
This test will FAIL, showing the custom message
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Failure Analysis
    # This test demonstrates failure messages
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Failure Analysis
    ${expected}    Set Variable    10
    ${actual}    Set Variable    5
    Should Be Equal    ${actual}    ${expected}    msg=Values do not match: expected ${expected} but got ${actual}
hints: Include actual and expected in message
They tell you what went wrong
Note: This test will fail by design
